newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shrs slip in light trade as interest wanes.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shrs slip in light trade as interest wanes.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange slipped lower in sluggish trade as interest from foreign and local investors waned, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19 share index fell 0.40 percent to 6,164.41 as 13 stocks rose, 19 slipped and eight closed flat.
"The exchange was slow, as was expected," one broker said.
A total of 2.548 billion bolivars ($5.4 million) changed hands, the exchange said.

Among leading stocks, banks were buoyed slightly by a report from Standard and Poor's that said Venezuela's financial sector was virtually over the 1994-95 crisis that saw over half the commercial banking sector fall into state hands.

Leading bank Banco Provincial rose 8.00 bolivars to 1152.00 bolivars and Banco Mercantil type B shares rose 110.25 bolivars to 2140.00 bolivars. Benchmark Electricidad de Caracas slipped 7.50 bolivars to 527.50 bolivars and national telephone company CANTV rose 44.00 bolivars to 1745.00 bolivars.
